{{Otheruses|Chief Engineer}}
'''Chief engineer''' was the title bestowed to lead [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]]. One such example was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bevel Lemelisk]], lead designer of the Empire's [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle stations]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
